# dsh-family-catalog
A DSH Community Market **standard catalog source** for the PerryLink DeepSeek Harness plugin family,
generated from the npm registry, validated against the public v1 contract schemas. Every item's `di
splayName` is bilingual (English — 中文) and its `summary` carries the Chinese line, so Chinese stays
visible and searchable inside the strict 1.0.0 fields. The pure Chinese pair and the display/status
metadata the public schema does not allow live in `display.json`.

- Manifest: `catalog-source.json` (generated; see Deploy)
- Provider page: `artifacts/v1/plugins.jso

n` (generated)
- Source of truth: `data/packages.json` (npm name → repo → display name → categories)

+ `data/npm-snapshot.json` (npm registry snapshot)
- Generator / validator: `scripts/build-catalog.

mjs`, `scripts/validate.mjs`, `scripts/check-counts.mjs`
- Deploy: live at `https://perrylink-dsh-ca
talog.perrylink.workers.dev` (Cloudflare Workers, automated via `deploy.yml`; Vercel static alternat
ive in `vercel.json`; Deno unit `deploy/deno-worker.js` as manual alternative)
*Workflow overview: install → open panel → act. The catalog is the discovery surface.*

## Compliance notes
- Contract: catalog-provider-contract.md (v1, `manifestVersion`/`schemaVersion` `1.0.0`). The schema
s are vendored nowhere in this repo; `scripts/validate.mjs` mirrors the structural rules of `catalog
-source.schema.json` and `catalog-provider-page.schema.json` and the cross-field rules (unique item

ids, npm name pattern, no install commands in items, HTTPS repository URLs, page shape).
- The provi
der advertises `query.supported = ["cursor","limit"]`, `defaultLimit = maxLimit = 100`, `sorts = []`
. The endpoint serves the complete 146-item catalog in cursor pages of up to 100 items (two requests
), so DSH Desktop scans the whole catalog without exceeding the runtime's per-page limit. The Vercel
static mirror serves the unpaginated 145-item JSON for browsing; use the workers.dev manifest for D

esktop.
- Every item carries `package.registry = "npm"` + `package.name` and a canonical `repository

.url`; no install commands, shell fragments or executable data are ever emitted.
- Every item also c
arries a same-origin `media.icon` (`/icons/<slug>.png`, generated deterministically by `scripts/buil
d-icons.mjs`); the Worker serves the PNGs itself, so the icons stay on the catalog origin as the mar

ket media rule requires.
- The manifest endpoint and the manifest itself must share one HTTPS origin
(market rule). The generated placeholder endpoint `https://replace-with-deploy-origin.invalid/...`
is replaced by the real deploy origin at deploy time — do not register the placeholder URL in DSH De
laced by the real deploy origin at deploy time — do not register the placeholder URL in DSH Desktop.
